'''Vervikks''', also called '''space rats''', were meter-long creatures with very sharp teeth. They often infested [[Starship/Legends|starships]], damaging systems and attacking repairmen. The [[SPD-R4 spider droid]]s on the ''[[Another Chance]]'' were programmed to exterminate them.
